  • Expert-level familiarity with containerization (i.e., Docker) and proven experience deploying and managing applications on Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Experience with REST APIs and/or distributed micro-service architecture.
  • Experience in writing and setting up comprehensive tests (unit and integration tests).
  • Strong communication skills in English and a passion for clean and understandable code.

The Team:

The Engine Orchestration team builds and operates the distributed services that run, scale and balance the analytical query engines. We are the layer that turns a customer's model into something they and their AI agents can query interactively using our Process Query Language across enterprise-sized datasets.

The team actively evolves our new premium query engine, collaborating with multiple other teams across time zones. New features, improved operationability, robust security, and allowing for scalable customer workloads are ours to design and ship.

Our defining program right now is a multi-year migration of the query engine that has powered Celonis for years onto our new premium query engine. It is one of the largest and highest-leverage engineering efforts in the company.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead both the engineering that evolves the new premium query engine and the execution of milestones within the migration program that moves customer workloads onto it.

This is not a lift and shift. The two query engines evolved with different focus areas and the new premium query engine serves different forward looking use cases, so the job is keeping customer workloads running seamlessly throughout. You will analyze how the engines differ on real customer workloads, develop tooling, classify the root causes, and turn them into concrete follow up actions across teams.

Continuous operations are a crucial part of your job. You will help keep the engines and their orchestration healthy while the entire fleet moves underneath them, because a migration on this scale does not get a pause in customer traffic to work with.

Your work at Celonis will directly impact companies and people around the globe as they improve their processes to save money, reduce waste, improve automation and generally become more efficient.

The work you’ll do:

  • Lead the design and delivery of the services our team owns across new and existing microservices in Java, Spring, RabbitMQ and Postgres, from architecture through to production operation
  • Evolve the new premium query engine by owning and delivering entire feature sets addressing new and extended use cases, tightened security robustness, and closing gaps
  • Drive query engine migration milestones end to end and ensure operationability across  their shared libraries as dependency workflows grow more frequent and complex
  • Establish and extend AI agent tooling to carry repetitive operational and development processes across our team
  • Sustain the operational and security robustness of our Tier 0 and Tier 1 services throughout feature development and the migration, and take part and improve how the on-call rotation works

  • 5+ years of professional experience building Java applications that are scalable, reliable and testable, including owning it in production
  • Fluency in Java and Python is required
  • Strong experience with data-intensive, performance-critical distributed systems
  • Experience rolling out changes across a large fleet of distributed systems, and the instinct for incremental, reversible, measurable steps that comes with it
  • A track record of developing and operating systems that process data workloads at scale
  • Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms from a performance point of view, and of asynchronous and concurrent programming
  • Ability to turn a vague, customer-facing problem into a concrete executable plan, and to explain that plan to stakeholders who are not engineers
  • Excellent communication skills in English, German is a plus
  • Preferred experience: Java Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Databases, C++

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.)

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

As Principal Growth Manager, EMEA, you will own a book of RZR's largest and most complex accounts in the region, including top-tier gaming publishers that spend at the very top of our platform. You will be the senior expert in the room: diagnosing performance, building multi-quarter growth plans, and turning data into a case that clients' leadership will act on.

You will report to our Chief Revenue Officer and work closely with Analytics, Ad Ops, Product, and New Business. As the most senior individual contributor on the EMEA Growth team, you will also be the go-to mentor for other Growth Managers and share what works on large accounts across the team.

This role exists now because our biggest EMEA accounts are growing fast and need a senior owner with deep DSP expertise, someone who can run them independently from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Ownership

  • Own a book of top-tier EMEA accounts and drive net revenue growth and retention against quarterly targets.
  • Build and run multi-quarter growth plans for each account, with clear revenue milestones and expansion plays across User Acquisition, Retargeting and CTV.
  • Lead QBRs and strategic sessions with client leadership, and build relationships well above the day-to-day contact.

Performance & Insight

  • Diagnose performance shifts and run test roadmaps across creative, audience and bidding with our Analytics and Ad Ops teams.
  • Translate complex technical topics such as SKAN, MMP attribution, bidding and LTV optimization into clear strategy for clients.

Revenue Operations

  • Own the revenue forecast for your book and be accountable for its accuracy.
  • Spot churn risk early and manage it, with clear escalation paths and documentation.

Team Leverage

  • Mentor Growth Managers, share playbooks from large-account work, and bring EMEA market intelligence to leadership.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 6+ years in mobile advertising or ad tech, including 5+ years client-facing in growth, account management or customer success at a DSP, ad network or programmatic platform.

  • CTV or retargeting experience.
  • Mentoring or informal team-lead experience.
  • A second EMEA business language (German, French, Turkish or similar).

Why Join RZR in London?

  • The biggest accounts in the region. You will hold relationships with top-tier gaming publishers, where your recommendations move millions in spend.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners. 

What makes our team unique:

  • Our global Security team aspires to be the world’s most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash).
  • We’re shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our “classic” platforms of the three companies.
  • The greater team is not just information security - we’re more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.

 

This position is open in our Wolt hubs in Berlin, Germany, or Helsinki, Finland, and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.

 

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

 

  • Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build “paved paths” that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.

  • Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership.

  • Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime.

  • Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor.

  • Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation.

  • Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

  • Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

 

Over time, your role can evolve depending on your interests and skills. Our company is  a large place and there’s a lot to do!

 

As the Security team sometimes needs to address high-priority security issues as well as ensure the availability of the components we have built, this position includes an on-call duty. On-call compensation and terms will be agreed separately in accordance with the local employment law.

 

Our humble expectations* 

  • Able to demonstrate a track record of driving improvements to a company’s infrastructure security posture.

  • Breadth of technical experience across various infrastructure and security areas running in large production environments.

  • Highly skilled in distributed systems and platforms development using program languages such as Java/Scala/Kotlin, Golang, or Python.

  • Strong experience with infrastructure as a code tooling like Terraform.

  • Expertise with cloud infrastructure and management in AWS.

  • Experience solving complex, systemic issues that require creative thinking and solutions.

  • Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to review design documents with respect to cloud infrastructure, security and engineering personnel.

  • Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities with minimal oversight.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions.

As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. You will take problems that begin as a customer commitment, a contractual obligation, or an unexploited spacecraft capability, and turn them into an operational concept that engineering teams can build and operators can run.

You will operate with substantial latitude, working closely with spacecraft and systems engineering groups to understand what current and future fleets are capable of, with the software and operations teams who build and run the systems you're changing, and with Product and customer-facing teams to stay anchored to commitments and SLA risk. Being effective across those boundaries is a core part of this job.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Serve as a primary technical interface for the team with stakeholders across engineering, operations, and product
  • Translate contractual and customer obligations into operational concepts and capacity commitments the fleet can actually meet
  • Model and analyze fleet performance with operational data to identify where capacity, latency, or agility are being left on the table
  • Design, develop, and maintain the software solutions that implement these concepts
  • Act as a recognized subject-matter expert across Planet and provide technical mentorship within the team

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in spacecraft operations, mission systems engineering, or a closely related field

  • Quantitative approach, including statistical analysis and reasoning over large operational datasets
  • A track record of leading technical initiatives across organizational boundaries
  • Ability to communicate and negotiate technical positions with senior stakeholders
  • Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience operating or designing operations for a large-scale satellite constellation
  • Background in optimization, scheduling, or operations research
  • Experience taking a new mission from design through commissioning and nominal operations
  • Familiarity with commercial Earth Observation, tasking, or fulfillment systems
  • Experience in a customer- or partner-facing technical role
  • Familiarity with orbital mechanics, link budgets, and spacecraft resource modeling
  • Experience with DevOps tooling and practices (Git, GitLab, Docker, CI/CD, Linux, Sentry, Datadog)

description:
Product Manager -  Robotic Picking | Outbound | Hybrid Working | Hatfield


We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role:

As the Product Manager for Robotic Picking (OGRP), you will own Ocado’s flagship automated picking capability, which has completed over 350 million picks in production to date. Sitting within our Outbound Product Area, you will operate at the intersection of software, robotics and physical operations - optimising performance and profitability where decisions show up in production within days, not quarters.

Operating as the highest individual contributor level in Product, you will serve as a recognized domain authority for Product Directors and VPs, with the capability and strategic breadth to step into a Director role. Day to day, you will manage the boundary between what the robot can reliably pick, how orders get planned and packed and what the CFC can execute without losing throughput or delivery quality. You will drive cross-area strategy, influence senior engineering counterparts and collaborate with commercial leaders to accelerate feature adoption and scale OGRP across new global sites.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the vision, roadmap and adoption outcomes for Ocado’s on-grid robotic picking (OGRP) capability.

  • Manage product range extension, using data on damage rates and pick success to balance range growth against operational risk.

  • Design seamless integration between robotic picking, manual stations order packing and downstream CFC workflows.

  • Lead exception design and site readiness, establishing criteria that allow OGRP to launch reliably across diverse global layouts.

  • Drive rigorous experimentation and hypothesis testing, holding cross-functional teams to high standards of evidence and validation.

  • Maintain clear visibility over P&L lines influenced by your domain, making critical Build vs. Buy calls and establishing metrics tied directly to business outcomes.

  • Serve as the primary market intelligence resource and go-to domain expert for Product Directors, VPs and external partners.

  • Mobilise and lead through expertise and influence, mentoring surrounding PMs and actively contributing to the broader product leadership group.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A seasoned Product Leader/Manager with a proven track record of driving impact at scale within complex technical or commercial domains.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex business environments and influence organizational strategy at the senior leadership and C-suite level.

  • Strong data and commercial fluency, with the ability to manage P&L impacts, build financial rationales and defend prioritization decisions.

  • Comfort making high-quality, decisive choices under conditions of ambiguity, high operational stakes and physical constraints.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting complex product strategies to internal leadership and external clients.

Nice to Haves:

  • Valuable expertise in robotics, automated fulfilment, warehouse operations or complex hardware/software integrations.

Benefits:

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

  • Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

  • Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.

  • Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE) and interest-free loans for train tickets.

  • Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme, Car salary sacrifice and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

  • Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month) and up to 70% off at our Company Shop.

Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. title: Engineering Manager, ChatBots and AI
description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Workato is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the ChatBots and AI team within our Platform organization. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity: you turn unclear requirements into clear execution plans, make confident decisions with incomplete information, and keep both the team and leadership aligned. The team is fully remote and international - you'll build the processes and culture that make it work at pace.

About the Team

The ChatBots and AI team's mission is to deliver AI agents to end users. We own the runtime and integration layer - conversation storage, API design, streaming, and integrations with external interfaces like Slack and other applications. The team is made up of Senior and Staff engineers working in Ruby/Rails and Go on a modern stack: PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and AWS. You'll collaborate with dedicated QA, SRE, and UX/UI teams, as well as engineering teams across the broader organization. Workato has a strong cross-functional culture - your team won't work in isolation.

What You'll Do

Delivery

  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to scope projects, set timelines, and define what success looks like

  • Plan and track execution across quarters and sprints; deliver on schedule without compromising quality

  • Identify blockers early, resolve them decisively, and escalate when escalation is the right call

  • Balance feature work against internal investments - AI-SDLC, CI/CD, platform upgrades, and technical debt

Team

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of Senior and Staff engineers

  • Own hiring, onboarding, and performance management

  • Design team processes that fit a distributed, asynchronous environment - and evolve them as the team and company change

  • Apply AI tooling to how the team works, not just what it builds

Technical Ownership

  • Participate in architecture and design decisions as a technical peer to your engineers

  • Make trade-off calls on scope, approach, and sequencing - and be accountable for them

  • Understand the system deeply enough to allocate the team's capacity where it matters most

Communication

  • Keep leadership informed on progress, risks, and blockers with clarity and without spin

  • Build working relationships with peer leads across engineering and product

  • Represent your team's priorities and constraints in cross-team planning

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years managing engineering teams, including Senior and Staff-level individual contributors

  • Senior engineer-level technical depth - you can read the code, challenge a design, and hold your own in an architecture discussion

  • Hands-on background in backend engineering; experience with Ruby, Go, or comparable languages and distributed systems

  • Demonstrated ability to operate under ambiguity: defining direction where none exists, and committing to decisions before all the information is available

  • Track record of shipping complex software on schedule in a fast-moving environment

  • Experience managing a fully remote, distributed team across multiple time zones

  • Strong written communication - in an async environment, writing is the primary management tool

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered products - agents, LLM pipelines, or orchestration systems

  • Background in platform, integration, or developer-facing infrastructure

  • Experience scaling a team through periods of rapid growth

  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS or automation platforms

title: Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

 

This position is based in Rennes, France.

Chance to apply closes: 6th of November 2026.

 

The Solutions Engineer at IDnow is the client's trusted advisor through pre-sales and integration. You design the solution the client will rely on, you give them confidence that it will work in their environment, and you become the person they turn to for technical and solution decisions. Your focus is the technical side of the journey up to the point where the client is live on our products, and you make that path smooth. 

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role, and a commercial one. Solutions Engineers carry a quota and are measured on two things: the deals they help win, and whether the client goes live successfully. You work hand in hand with Sales to convince the client that our solution is the right one and to move them toward signature, and then you make sure they can use it well in production. You earn that through technical depth, but you are client-facing, credible and persuasive in a sales motion. You do this across our whole client base.

We hire this role at more than one level. The core of the job is the same; the scope you own and the complexity you handle grow with your experience. This role carries real ownership across the client journey, and a say in how the work evolves.

 

Key Responsibilities

Discover and Design

  • Lead technical discovery, qualifying conversion rates, false acceptance and rejection trade-offs, fraud exposure and integration constraints before proposing a solution,
  • Design end-to-end solution architectures that orchestrate document verification, digital identity, fraud signals, biometric authentication, eID and EU Digital Identity Wallet flows, and e-signature,
  • Link every technical choice to the client’s business objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), so proposals speak to outcomes rather than features,
  • Define defensible architecture decisions covering fallback logic, data residency, scalability and performance,
  • Support Sales with proposals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), advising on which capabilities to combine and why.

Prove, Integrate and Go Live

  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot engagements, configuring Application Programming Interface (API) integrations, building Postman collections and managing sandbox environments,
  • Validate behaviour under realistic conditions and document what the client needs to go live,
  • Guide client developers through API and mobile Software Development Kit (SDK) integration, including webhooks, authentication and testing,
  • Troubleshoot integration issues by reading logs and diagnosing failures at the API and SDK level, rather than only forwarding them,
  • Maintain a living integration map of the client’s architecture, data flows and dependencies,
  • Own the account from signature to go-live, running the go-live plan and handing a documented account to Customer Success and Support at the end of hypercare.

Advise and Enable

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders, from first conversation to go-live,
  • Represent the client’s technical reality internally, feeding integration blockers, product gaps and pilot learnings back to Product and Sales teams,
  • Work with the internal escalation team on deeper platform issues, arriving with clear technical context,
  • Stand alongside Sales in client meetings, addressing objections on integration effort, feasibility and alternatives,
  • Improve demo environments, architecture templates and integration guides, and mentor team members as the practice grows.
 

Preferred Experience

You ask before you propose and qualify before you demo, turning ambiguous client requirements into the right technical solution. You take ownership of the client’s technical path from first conversation to production, and you explain complex systems in plain language to engineers and business leaders alike. You combine hands-on engineering depth with a commercial mindset, and you enjoy working alongside Sales to move a decision forward.

  • Engineering or technical degree, a Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience,
  • 3+ years of experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or implementation and onboarding in SaaS, ideally in identity, FinTech or security,
  • Discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to turn an ambiguous client requirement into the best technical solution,
  • Solution architecture skills, including designing integration flows, explaining orchestration logic and defending trade-offs with a client’s engineers,
  • Hands-on technical skills with APIs, Software Development Kits (SDKs) including mobile, and integration tooling such as Postman and Git,
  • Experience running a proof of concept and debugging an integration at the API or log level,
  • Delivery discipline to run an integration and onboarding through to a committed go-live date, managing several client projects at once,
  • The ability to translate technical complexity into plain language and reassure non-technical stakeholders,
  • Business value awareness, connecting the technical solution to client outcomes such as verification conversion, fraud loss or time to go-live,
  • Client-facing presence, building trusted advisor relationships with business stakeholders such as Chief Digital Officers (CDOs) and Heads of Digital, and technical stakeholders such as Chief Technology Officers (CTOs), architects and platform engineers,
  • The instinct to own the client’s technical path end to end,
  • Fluent English and full professional French are both hard requirements for the role. Additional European languages are a plus.

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with identity verification, Know Your Customer (KYC), Know Your Business (KYB) or Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes, including document verification, biometrics, liveness detection, eID and fraud detection,
  • Interest in where digital identity is heading, including eIDAS 2.0, EU Digital Identity Wallets, the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR),
  • Experience with mobile SDK delivery on iOS, Android or React Native,
  • Knowledge of web development concepts, including frontend and backend architecture, webhooks and Open Authorisation (OAuth),
  • Experience in mobility, FinTech, banking or other regulated industries,
  • Working knowledge of a programming language such as Python, Java or JavaScript, and of a cloud platform such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  

Perks & Benefits

  • Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions.
  • We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited content/course consumption incl. certification.
  • We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours.
  • We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect outside of work.
  • May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefit of our paid special leave days.
  • Enjoy the possibility to combine work with a longer stay at your holiday destination or extend a weekend with our Workcation possibilities.
  • In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.

 

IDnow applies the principles of non-discrimination and equality: We strive to establish, maintain, and promote an open and inclusive recruitment process and working environment by respecting the principles of equal opportunities. Including but not limited to: race or ethnic origin, religion or convictions, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

description: Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien. Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front. Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur. Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe. Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre. Ce que tu vas faire chez nous Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production. Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler. PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité. Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes. Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs. Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi. Ce qui t'attend techniquement Stack : TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour Profil recherché 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs. Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps. Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run. Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework. Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion. Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique. Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite. Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs. Processus de recrutement Echange RH Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs Prise de référence et offre Conditions Salaire : 50-65 k€ selon expérience Télétravail : full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie) Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team
raw.description:
Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join the Operations Tech team.

You’ll influence the technical direction of iwoca’s in-house CRM and build parts of it yourself – the system that hundreds of staff across sales, account management, credit, and collections use to give our customers five-star service.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Operations Tech team builds the tools iwoca’s UK operations teams use every day: the CRM, and the systems behind phone calls, emails, notifications, and task management. Those tools are a competitive advantage – they help colleagues manage risk and enable the outstanding customer service that sets iwoca apart.

The team works closely with the Operations Strategy team, which sets operational priorities and scopes much of the tooling. Many of its users work in the same building, and you’ll see how your changes affect the people you work with.

We’re growing the team to ten engineers (including this role), two of them tech leads, and two product owners. Most of its time goes on quarterly roadmap projects, alongside a support rota, and regular small feature improvements.

The role

As a staff backend engineer, you’ll take whole projects end to end: work out what operations teams need, design it, build it, and look after it in production. You’ll decide with the tech leads where the CRM’s service boundaries sit and how to model each domain’s data. You’ll judge your work by what it changes for those teams and their customers.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no line management, but you’ll mentor the engineers around you. You’ll often pair with a more junior engineer, share what you know, and set the standards the team works to through design discussions and code review.

You’ll learn how iwoca lends, from credit decisions to collections and financial crime. The team is adding AI to the CRM’s workflows, and you’ll have a say in where it helps.

Live project examples:

  • Migrating the monolith. Moving CRM functionality out of iwoca’s Django monolith into separate services, such as customer contact and phone calls, that deploy and scale on their own.

  • Building customer-facing AI agents to take the load off our teams as we grow, and the infrastructure to make them reliable and trustworthy

  • Improving our onboarding journey to so that there’s less manual work getting a customer their funds, for example using LLMs to speed up compliance checks

  • Credit card operations. Building the CRM services that let operations teams support customers on iwoca’s business credit card.

  • iwocaChat. Extending the Claude-powered assistant that answers operations staff questions about a customer, using data held across several systems.

The requirements

Essential:

  • System design. You’ve designed large production systems and the domain models at their core, and changed their architecture while people relied on them.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it.

  • Technical leadership. You’ve led technical decisions across a team as an individual contributor, and helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • Operational problems. You’ve worked with non-technical colleagues to understand a problem they had, and built the system that solved it.

  • AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Python stack. You’ve worked with Python, Django, Celery, and PostgreSQL.

  • Full-stack. You’ve contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • Monolith migration. You’ve moved functionality out of a large monolith into separate services, while both stayed in production.

  • Asynchronous systems. You’ve built services that communicate through message queues such as RabbitMQ.

  • Contact systems. You’ve worked on telephony, email, or messaging systems, such as Twilio.

  • Models in production systems. You’ve built systems that use model outputs to make operational decisions, such as which work to prioritise.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack (TAP)

Compensation: £100K – £130K

  • The AI platform. Access to the latest models, an internal Claude Code plugin marketplace, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools to iwoca’s systems.

The Platform team is part of Core Systems, a group of about a dozen people who provide the shared tools and infrastructure that iwoca’s engineering, data, and analytics teams rely on. You’ll be one of six engineers in the Platform team.

The role

As the Senior Platform Engineer, you’ll own the developer experience roadmap and agree with the team on where you can make the biggest impact for the platform’s users. You’ll decide how each self-service tool works and build it yourself, making clear trade-offs between developer experience, reliability, security, and cost. The tools you build help teams get code live faster which results in fewer support requests for the Platform team.

Today, getting a new service live takes many separate steps and a lot of platform knowledge. You’ll spend most of your time building new self-service tools, and the rest migrating existing tooling and talking to users about where they get stuck. If you haven’t worked deeply with Kubernetes, Terraform, or GitOps, you can learn them here, with the team and plenty of resources to help. You’ll likely start with the friction map below.

Live project examples:

  • Friction map. Measuring how long it takes someone outside Core Systems to get new code live, and how many steps they go through. The result could be written documentation or a dashboard.

  • New services. Turning the merge requests a new service needs into one guided flow, so fewer changes wait for review.

  • AI guardrails. Building the Claude skills and checks that help AI-written changes pass review and deploy cleanly first time.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Software engineering. You’ve written and maintained production code in Python or Go, including tools and automation.

  • Ownership. You’ve set the direction for a platform or tooling area and looked after it for the long term. You’ve decided what to fix first and seen the work through.

  • Building for internal users. You’ve built tooling and written documentation for other engineers, or for colleagues who aren’t engineers, and changed both based on how people used them.

  • AI leverage. You’ve used AI to produce work you couldn’t have delivered without it. You know where it speeds up changes, and where a change needs careful human review.

Bonus:

  • Kubernetes. You’ve deployed and debugged services on Kubernetes, and know its common resources and terms.

  • CI/CD and GitOps. You’ve built or maintained CI pipelines in GitLab CI or a similar system, and deployed services through a GitOps tool such as Flux or Argo CD.

  • Infrastructure as code. You’ve defined cloud resources in Terraform or a similar tool.

  • Delivery metrics. You’ve tracked measures such as lead time or deployment frequency, and used them to judge whether a change helped.

  • Developer environments. You’ve worked with cloud workspaces or devcontainers, and know what makes a developer environment pleasant to work in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission
As Workplace & People Operations Manager at telli, you own the environment our team does its best work in. You're responsible for keeping our Berlin office running smoothly day to day: workplace processes, people ops, internal events, and the culture initiatives that make telli feel like telli.

The team:

With over 8 million signers sold worldwide, Ledger Wallet is where Ledger users manage and grow their assets. Transactional Services (buy, sell, swap, trading and stablecoin products) is its main source of service revenue.

Money Flows connects users' crypto to the fiat world in both directions: on/off-ramp, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, and the growing P2P and Payments use cases. Users buy crypto with fiat or sell it back to their bank, move cash into stablecoins, and spend crypto with a card, all through specialist partners. It is the entry and exit door of the Ledger Wallet economy and a key lever to diversify Transactional Services revenue. The role reports to the Senior Director, Transactional Services.

You own and grow Money Flows end to end - revenue, economics, partner ecosystem and the quality of every fiat journey in Ledger Wallet - with a General Manager mindset over a business run mostly through external partners and cross-functional teams. title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. raw.description:
The opportunity

Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now.

The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build.

The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. What you'll do

Architecture above DATEV

  • Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath.

  • Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck.

  • Make integration a capability, not a project: every client brings their own upstream systems, and today each connection is built by hand. Build the layer those systems plug into, so what makes a client different arrives as context the agents read, never as custom code. One more client must never mean one more integration project.

Reproducibility and control

  • A tax advisor must get the same result twice, and an auditor must be able to trace it. Probabilistic where there is variance, deterministic where there are numbers.

  • Build the control layer so that a certified professional sees within seconds what an agent did (version, source, decision) and can sign off on it.

  • Build evaluation on decades of audited, completed work.

Team and scale

  • Make the architecture calls: design, stack, build or buy for the layer. Nobody has decided it for you, and nobody will overrule it by committee.

  • Hire and lead the engineering team. The budget for your first engineers is approved. You start hiring in your first quarter.

  • Make every acquired firm land on the same base, so technology scales with every acquisition. And stay in the code: you commit and you review.

Questions you'll answer

  • Where exactly does probabilistic end and deterministic begin?

  • How does a system learn from closed cases without losing its reproducibility?

  • A new client arrives with their own systems. What may change in the system, and what may not?

What success looks like

  • 6 months: Architecture decided. One real use case from the core business runs in production and is used daily. Your first engineers are hired.

  • 12 months: Several agentic use cases in regular operation. The control layer holds up in a real review, and evaluation runs against closed cases, not test data.

  • 24 months: Automation is a capability of the organization, not of individuals. Every acquired firm runs on the same base, and your team ships without you in the room.

Where it leads: the full CTO mandate, a management career earned by contribution, not by years served.

What you bring

  • You have built something that ran in production and was used by people who did not build it, as founding engineer, engineering lead, technical co-founder or in a comparable role.

  • You have taken agentic systems into production and know where they break.

  • You have integrated against systems that fight back: legacy ERPs, banking backends, badly documented interfaces.

  • You write production code. AI is your everyday tool, and your position on the stack comes from what you built and threw away.

  • You work in German, because our clients and tax advisors do, and you build in person in Munich.

  • You learn from practitioners, and you set the highest standard in everything you ship, not because someone checks, but because mediocrity bothers you.

A plus, not a requirement

  • A regulated field where mistakes have consequences: fintech, banking tech, payments (N26, Trade Republic, Solaris, Klarna, Mollie, Pleo) or software for professional services (Personio, Workato).

  • Knowledge of accounting, tax or DATEV.

  • No conventional CV required: a technical co-founder of a sold or failed product, or someone who can show publicly what they have built, is explicitly invited. We assess contribution, not labels. The salary range shown refers to the primary profile; a different background starts at a different market price and converges after twelve months of proven performance.

What this role is and what it isn't

  • Building, not managing. You lead engineers and stay in the code. If you want to run managers, this is the wrong role.

  • An operating company, not a software vendor. The users are our own teams. IT operations, tool rollouts and the product work sit with Operations; what we build and in which order is decided together with management. You own how it is built and run.

  • In person in Munich, not a distributed team. An architecture being decided and a team finding its standards need a shared room.

Why join us

  • Turn our data into the edge. Decades of audited, completed work become the test every agent has to pass before a human sees its result.

  • Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build. One decision of yours reaches several thousand clients from day one, and more with every acquisition.

  • Yours to decide. The architecture and the stack of this layer are open. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater.

  • Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your team exists.

title: Elektroniker (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Embodied AI, das die menschliche Arbeitswelt revolutioniert. Mit modernster Robotik und fortschrittlicher künstlicher Intelligenz entwickeln wir transformative Technologien, die neu definieren, wie Arbeit über verschiedenste Branchen hinweg erledigt wird — und ermöglichen es Unternehmen, Abläufe zu optimieren, die Produktivität zu steigern und neue Möglichkeiten zu erschließen. Überblick Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Electroniker, der die elektrische Verkabelung und Steuerungssysteme unserer autonomen Robotersysteme installiert, verkabelt und in Stand hält. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit unserem Mechanical- und Hardware-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle elektrischen Komponenten zuverlässig funktionieren und nahtlos in die Gesamtsysteme integriert sind. Deine Aufgaben Elektrokonstruktion und Planung: Elektrokonstruktion gemäß geltenden Richtlinien und Normen. Erstellung von Schaltplänen für unsere Robotersysteme. Installation und Verkabelung: Verkabelung und Installation elektrischer Komponenten und Steuerungssysteme in unseren Robotersystemen. Montage von Schaltschränken, Steckverbindern und Sensorik nach technischen Zeichnungen und Schaltplänen. Verlegung und Anschluss von Kabeln unter Einhaltung geltender Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards. Test, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung: Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Systeme vor Auslieferung und Installation beim Kunden. Diagnose und Behebung elektrischer Störungen während der Entwicklung, der Fertigung und im laufenden Betrieb. Durchführung regelmäßiger Wartungs- und Sicherheitsprüfungen an bestehenden Systemen. Unterstützung bei Vor-Ort-Installationen und Inbetriebnahmen beim Kunden. Reisebereitschaft ~50% Qualifikationen & Anforderungen Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Mechatroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sicherer Umgang mit Schaltplänen sowie Kenntnisse in Verkabelung, Verdrahtung und Anschlusstechnik. Erfahrung im Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten (z. B. Multimeter, Oszilloskop). Kenntnisse relevanter elektrischer Sicherheitsnormen und -vorschriften. Erfahrung in der Robotik, Automatisierungstechnik oder im Maschinenbau von Vorteil. description: Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Unsere Vision Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden. Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Über uns Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!). In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht. 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten. 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich! Du willst als Account Executive Steuerkanzleien im Raum Düsseldorf oder München für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video und vor Ort in der Kanzlei? Als eine:r der ersten Account Executives für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du dir dein eigenes Gebiet auf, verantwortest den gesamten Vertriebszyklus bis zum Onboarding und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Firms-Team den Vertriebsansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas. Unsere Vision Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden. Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln. Über uns Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen. 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft. Deine Mission Du wirst eine:r der ersten Account Executives (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du baust dir deine Pipeline selbst auf, überzeugst Kanzleiinhaber:innen in der Demo und vor Ort und begleitest deine Kanzleien vom Abschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding. In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du arbeitest mit dem bewährten Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director, an den du zunächst direkt berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an – als eine:r der Ersten gestaltest du mit, wie Pennylane hier an Kanzleien verkauft. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Sales Firms Director, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland. Dein Team Full-Cycle Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management deiner Kanzleien. Outbound ist Kern: Rund 50 % deiner Pipeline baust du selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Ergänzt wird das durch Inbound-Leads und Empfehlungen. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr. Starkes Setup: Dabei bist du nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt dich bei Onboarding und Betreuung deiner Kanzleien, damit du genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung hast. Regional organisiert: Du betreust eine feste Region – Düsseldorf/Nordrhein-Westfalen oder München/Bayern – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien. Deshalb suchen wir dich dort, wo deine Kanzleien sind. Im Aufbau: Du kommst zu einem kleinen Team von Account Executives dazu, das mit dir wächst – bald unter der Führung eines Team Leads Sales Firms in Berlin. Beratender Vertrieb: Du gewinnst Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Du machst den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schaffst Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform. Remote in deiner Region: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice oder Coworking in deiner Region und bist regelmäßig bei Kanzleien vor Ort, auf Messen und bei Verbandsveranstaltungen. Etwa einmal im Monat kommst du für Team-Treffen in unser Berliner Office. Du wirst für den Erfolg deiner Region verantwortlich sein durch: Du verantwortest den MRR aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region und trägst zur Marktdurchdringung von Pennylane im deutschen Kanzleisegment bei. Du baust eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst deine Aktivitätsquoten hoch. Du führst Bedarfsanalysen und Produktdemos durch und begleitest komplexe Entscheidungsprozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern bis zum Abschluss. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Customer Success für eine reibungslose Übergabe und baust deine Kanzleien aus, indem du die Anzahl der über Pennylane betreuten Mandanten steigerst.
