adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Quantitative Academic Foundation: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. You are available to contribute up to 20 hours per week during the semester.

  • ML Model Prototyping: You will support the research and evaluation of deep learning and machine learning models that predict user behavior across our 770 million user base. We are looking for solid Python skills and hands-on familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and gradient boosting libraries (LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost) to prototype new algorithms.

  • Large-Scale Data Exploration: Operating on our 1PB+ behavioral data lake, you will extract patterns from terabytes of data to engineer high-fidelity features for our training pipelines. This requires strong SQL fundamentals, an interest in distributed query engines (AWS Athena, Trino, Spark), and fluency with pandas, polars, and NumPy.

  • Experimentation & Validation: You will collaborate closely with our data scientists to test your fit-for-purpose solutions against our multi-objective optimization problem. We need someone who can rigorously evaluate models through offline experiments and A/B tests before they hit our 100,000+ predictions-per-second production environment.

  • Plus: ML Infrastructure Exposure: Any prior exposure to the systems that run our real-time scale—AWS, workflow orchestration (Airflow), containerization (Docker), or basic model deployment workflows—will accelerate your impact.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

Used cars are the biggest part of the UK car market, and Carwow is going all in. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it's bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too.

We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. AI changes what's possible here. A dealer shouldn't have to work out what a car is worth, write the advert or chase the buyer; the product should do it for them. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that looks like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to separate real dealer value from noise.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Obsess over dealers:

    • Spend time with dealers: visit forecourts, sit with sales teams and learn how they buy, price and sell

    • Run your own discovery through interviews, usage data and behavioural analysis, so every decision starts from a real dealer problem

  • Set the direction and deliver:

    • Set the product direction for the partner side of Carwow Used, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Make supply effortless: get dealer stock onto Carwow with no manual effort, through feeds and integrations, stock upload and cars bought via Sell My Car listing automatically

    • Build the data products that help dealers trade profitably: what to buy, what to pay, what to price at and how fast it will sell

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work so the squad learns faster and ships more

    • Lead a product trio with engineering and design: shape dealer journeys, test them before build, and make the right calls on data quality, integrations and build versus buy

  • Commercial sharpness: you understand how dealers make money and can connect product decisions to their margin and stock turn, and to Carwow revenue

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this is a new vertical, so the role involves defining the problem as much as solving it

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about data pipelines, integrations and architecture

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you\

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with pricing, valuation or demand-forecasting products

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

title: Senior Counsel, Commercial (pipeline req for EMEA)
description: ClickHouse is seeking an experienced commercial lawyer to join ClickHouse’s elite and business-focused Legal team. You will be responsible for supporting ClickHouse’s EMEA sales team in reviewing and negotiating customer agreements and providing legal support for ClickHouse’s revenue-generating activities. You’ll be a trusted advisor and business enabler in a rapidly growing company while maintaining high standards for both legal practice and business ethics. What You’ll Do: Serve as a senior member of the commercial legal team responsible for supporting the go-to-market team by reviewing and negotiating ClickHouse’s customer contracts. Your primary focus will be supporting the EMEA sales team. Cultivate strong relationships with the EMEA sales team and act as a solutions-oriented business partner to ClickHouse’s EMEA sales team by providing pragmatic, sound legal counsel. Lead complex cross-border transactions with sophisticated counterparties located across multiple jurisdictions, independently owning complex deals from first review through signature and managing escalations. Monitor and advise on relevant regulatory, compliance, or legal developments impacting the business in the EMEA region, and partner with the broader Legal team and cross-functional stakeholders where required. Provide training and enablement to internal stakeholders on legal issues and contract processes, and mentor more junior members of the Legal team. Help maintain and update our legal agreements, policies, and templates; develop and improve scalable workflows to enable rapid revenue growth and stability for the company. As a senior member of ClickHouse’s EMEA legal function, lead the build-out of the playbooks, templates, and processes the region will run on, in partnership with the broader Legal team. What You Bring Along: Qualified lawyer in good standing in the UK or another European jurisdiction, with the right to work in the hiring location; local qualification (or active pursuit of it) a plus. Minimum of 7 years of law firm and in-house experience. Experience supporting a high growth infrastructure SaaS company is a plus. Exceptional academic performance and training, including a law degree from a highly ranked university and/or experience at a top-tier law firm in the technology space. Proven track record of independently drafting, negotiating, and closing complex commercial technology transactions and SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, partners, and resellers across multiple jurisdictions. International legal experience is a plus. Strong understanding of commercial legal issues related to SaaS and software licensing (i.e., data privacy, security, intellectual property, open-source, revenue recognition, and tax), professional services, and other go-to-market programs (such as partner/reseller programs). Excellent judgement, strong business orientation, and ability to translate legal risk into practical commercial advice within the context of business objectives. Strong interpersonal, communication, and management skills; ability to build trust and strong relationships with ClickHouse’s sales team, cross-functional stakeholders, and ClickHouse’s customers. Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Experience with EU/UK data protection regulations in commercial negotiations and familiarity with regulated customer requirements (i.e., DORA) is a plus. Experience negotiating on customer paper and working with negotiation playbooks and fallback positions is a plus. Fluency in additional European languages is a plus. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. title: Senior Buchhalter - Finanz- & Lohnbuchhaltung (m/w/d)
description: Hier bei CloudFactory haben wir eine klare Mission. Wir wollen das Potenzial der künstlichen Intelligenz erschließen, um weltweit positive Veränderungen zu bewirken. Durch die Kombination aus fortschrittlicher Technologie und einem globalen Netzwerk talentierter Menschen machen wir ungenutzte Daten nutzbar und schaffen so weltweit echten Mehrwert im großen Maßstab. Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Wir sind eine globale Gemeinschaft, die auf starken Beziehungen und der Überzeugung basiert, dass sinnvolle Arbeit Leben verändert. Unser Leitprinzip „Earning, Learning, and Serving“ (Verdienen, Lernen und Dienen) prägt unser tägliches Handeln. Außerdem verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine Million Menschen mit zukunftsfähiger Arbeit zu verbinden und Führungspersönlichkeiten zu entwickeln, die andere inspirieren. Unsere Kultur Bei CloudFactory glauben wir daran, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle bestärkt, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen. Jeder soll seine eigene Persönlichkeit und individuellen Stärken bei der Arbeit voll entfalten können. Wir sind: Missionsorientiert: Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, wirtschaftliche und gesellschaftliche Wirkung zu erzielen. Menschenzentriert: Die persönliche Weiterentwicklung, das Wohlbefinden und das Zugehörigkeitsgefühl unseres Teams liegen uns sehr am Herzen. Innovativ: Wir begrüßen Veränderungen und finden gemeinsam bessere Wege, Dinge anzugehen. Global vernetzt: Wir fördern die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Kulturen und Perspektiven. Wenn Sie sich für Innovation und Zusammenarbeit begeistern und in einem internationalen Umfeld wirklich etwas bewegen möchten, dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie in unserem Team willkommen zu heißen! Ihre Position im Team Als unser Senior Accountant - Finance & Payroll (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Finanzbuchhaltung, die Lohnabrechnung sowie die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen Vorgaben für die deutsche Tochtergesellschaft von CloudFactory, die Hasty GmbH mit Sitz in Berlin. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem globalen Group Finance Team sowie den lokalen Fachabteilungen zusammen. Die Rolle bietet Ihnen ideale Voraussetzungen, sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und gleichzeitig Teil eines sinnstiftenden Unternehmens zu sein. Arbeitsmodell Hybrid / Remote-first - weitgehend mobiles Arbeiten, kombiniert mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in unserem Büro in Berlin (mindestens ein Tag alle zwei Wochen) für den persönlichen Austausch und lokale Aufgaben. Vergütung Diese Position ist sowohl in Vollzeit als auch in Teilzeit zu besetzen. Das Einstiegsgehalt beträgt auf Vollzeitbasis (FTE) 4.311 EUR brutto pro Monat. Die Auszahlung erfolgt monatlich für Vollzeitbeschäftigte. Bei Teilzeitbeschäftigten wird die Vergütung anteilig auf Grundlage der tatsächlich geleisteten Arbeitsstunden berechnet. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Laufende Finanzbuchhaltung: Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung des Tagesgeschäfts (Kontierung sowie Debitoren-, Kreditoren- und Anlagenbuchhaltung) und Sicherstellung einer aktuellen, ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung. Organisation der Entgeltabrechnung: Verantwortung für die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung in Deutschland, einschließlich Gehaltsanpassungen, Personalveränderungen, lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlicher Meldungen sowie enger Abstimmung mit dem lokalen HR-Team. Steuerliche Themen & Compliance: Vorbereitung, Koordination und fristgerechte Abgabe aller erforderlichen Steuererklärungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Steuerberater. Schnittstelle für Prüfer und Behörden: Hauptansprechperson für externe Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater und deutsche Finanzbehörden, einschließlich der Unterstützung bei gesetzlichen Jahresabschlussprüfungen und der Beantwortung von fachlichen Rückfragen. Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse: Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Group Finance Team zur Sicherstellung einer präzisen Finanzberichterstattung. Corporate Governance & Verwaltung: Koordination gesellschaftsrechtlicher und administrativer Prozesse der deutschen Niederlassung in Zusammenarbeit mit der lokalen Geschäftsführung und internen Stakeholdern. Büro Management & Onboarding: Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung des Berliner Büros, einschließlich der Koordination von On- und Offboarding-Prozessen für Mitarbeitende und externe Dienstleister (Contractors). Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit lokalen und globalen Teams, um reibungslose Finanzprozesse und eine schnelle Klärung operativer Fragestellungen sicherzustellen. Kultur & Miteinander: Aktive Mitgestaltung einer positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre am Standort Berlin, beispielsweise durch die Unterstützung lokaler Gemeinschaftsprojekte und Mitarbeiteraktivitäten. Requirements Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die tägliche Kommunikation mit deutschen Behörden, externen Beratern und dem internationalen Team. Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung im Bereich Buchhaltung/Finanzen (z. B. als Steuerfachangestellte/r), idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter/-in (IHK) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen mit nachweislicher Verantwortung für die laufende Buchhaltung. HGB- & Steuerkenntnisse: Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit deutschen Rechnungslegungs- und Steuervorschriften (HGB), idealerweise im Umfeld einer GmbH oder einer vergleichbaren deutschen Kapitalgesellschaft. Entgeltabrechnung: Praktische Erfahrung in der deutschen Entgeltabrechnung, einschließlich des dazugehörigen Meldewesens. Abschluss- und Prüfungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung oder Koordination von Jahresabschlüssen und Steuererklärungen nach deutschem Recht sowie effektive und professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern, Wirtschaftsprüfern und deutschen Finanzbehörden. Arbeitsweise & Persönlichkeit: Selbstständige, strukturierte und äußerst sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie eine klare und souveräne Kommunikation gegenüber externen und internen Ansprechpartnern. title: Senior Program Manager, EL2 European Tour
description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead the planning and execution of a European tour for Electra's EL2 technology demonstrator aircraft. This role will serve as the primary team lead for the EL2 program, partnering closely with engineering, flight test, government and commercial stakeholders, and company leadership to ensure the tour achieves its strategic objectives safely, on schedule, and within budget. After the completion of the European tour this role will transition to supporting EL9.  The exact nature of this support will depend on the candidates specific skills and interest areas; likely options include test team program management, program office support, or leading teams executing government contract

What You'll Do

Tour Planning and Strategy

  • Develop a master schedule, budget, and resourcing plan for the tour, including aircraft transport/ferry logistics, ground support, and personnel deployment to meet the overall mission objectives and success critera.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Business Development, and Government Affairs to prioritization of target locations, stakeholders, and events (e.g., customer demonstrations, government engagements, airshows) across the tour itinerary.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with Flight Test and Engineering teams to ensure the aircraft, crew, and support equipment are mission-ready for each tour stop
  • Coordinate with Legal, Regulatory, and International Trade/Export Control functions to secure necessary permissions, airspace access, and customs clearances for international operations
  • Serve as the central point of coordination between internal teams and external partners, hosts, and government counterparts at each location
  • Manage vendor and logistics partners supporting ground operations, transport, and lodging

Risk Management and Execution

  • Identify, track, and mitigate risks related to schedule, safety, logistics, weather, and geopolitical factors across tour locations
  • Develop contingency plans for schedule disruptions, maintenance needs, or changes in stop-level objectives
  • Monitor tour execution in real time and adjust plans as needed to maintain safety and achieve strategic goals
  • Maintain clear documentation and traceability of decisions, approvals, and changes throughout the tour

Reporting and Communication

  • Provide regular status updates to program and executive leadership on tour progress, risks, and outcomes
  • Capture and communicate lessons learned and stakeholder feedback from each tour stop
  • Support internal and external communications/marketing efforts related to the tour
  • Deliver a post-tour summary with key outcomes, metrics, and recommendations for future campaigns

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience (advanced degree a plus)
  • US Persons required
  • 8+ years in program or project management, ideally within aerospace, defense, or a related complex technical industry
  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with tight schedules and significant logistical coordination
  • Experience working with international operations, export control considerations, and cross-border logistics
  • Strong organizational and risk management skills, with the ability to adapt plans quickly in dynamic environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, flight test, legal, and business teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with government and/or customer audiences
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally, potentially for extended periods

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting flight test campaigns, demonstration tours, or airshow operations
  • Familiarity with European aviation regulatory environments and airspace coordination
  • Experience working with government or defense customers internationally
  • Prior experience with aircraft ferry/transport logistics

 

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

title: Marketing Director
description:
digiLab is a formative AI company with world-leading specialists in uncertainty quantification, applied where the stakes are highest and the margin for error is smallest.

Our customers are among the largest and most advanced engineering and science-led organisations in the world, and they're using our technology to tackle some of society's biggest challenges. How do we make fusion energy a commercial reality? Can we drive down the cost of renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a sustainable future? How do we support coral reef restoration, or strengthen Britain's national security? These are just a few of the critical questions our technology is helping to answer. 

At the heart of our work is digiLab's trustworthy and explainable AI platform, enabling our customers to accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and deliver real value through better informed decisions. 

We are looking for ambitious team members to help shape our pioneering technology and tackle some of the world's most impactful problems. 

Summary: 

This full-time position (Monday to Thursday), reporting to the Chief Marketing & Strategy Officer, leads the development and delivery of digiLab’s marketing programmes.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will help shape our positioning, develop campaigns, launch products and build the processes that make marketing effective as the company scales. You should be comfortable moving between strategic decisions and practical execution, from planning a market campaign to editing a customer story or improving a sales presentation. Your challenge will be to make sophisticated technology understandable and commercially relevant to engineering leaders, enterprise buyers and technology partners. You will work directly with technical and commercial leaders, with meaningful ownership of the marketing programme and its impact.

 

The role: 

As Marketing Director at digiLab, you will be responsible for:

  • Building integrated campaigns that generate qualified opportunities and support expansion within existing accounts.
  • Working with commercial leads on target-account programmes, events, webinars and prospect engagement.
  • Planning product launches and creating sales materials that explain what customers can buy, how it works and why it matters.
  • Establishing shared definitions and reporting for marketing contribution to pipeline, conversion and revenue.
  • Working with the research and product teams to translate technical work into compelling content.
  • Developing customer stories that connect technical outcomes with business value.
  • Building digiLab’s presence through relevant industry events and expert communities, maintaining accuracy in technical and commercial claims.
  • Developing joint campaigns, content and events with engineering and technology partners.
  • Giving partners the messaging and materials they need to introduce digiLab to their customers.
  • Owning the marketing calendar, budget and delivery process.
  • Managing agencies, freelancers and specialist suppliers, and helping build the internal team as requirements grow.
  • Improving the website, CRM integration, campaign measurement and content production process.
  • Prioritising the activities that deliver results within a startup’s resources.

Duties may evolve, and you may be asked to take on other reasonable responsibilities within your competence to support our growth.

Required Skills & Experience: 

  • Experience leading B2B marketing for enterprise software, AI, deep technology or a closely related business.
  • A record of translating complex products into clear propositions and effective campaigns.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles and working closely with commercial teams.
  • Practical knowledge of demand generation, digital channels, marketing measurement and HubSpot.
  • The ability to work credibly with technical specialists and draw out what matters to customers.
  • Experience managing budgets and external resources, with a willingness to do the work yourself.
  • Sound judgement about priorities, a collaborative approach and comfort operating with incomplete information.

description:
Data Engineer      

 

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

 

The role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to help build scalable data solutions that serve teams across the business—from data scientists and analysts to AI engineers and product teams. You'll contribute to both the underlying platform and the way data is used in our products, working in a modern, cloud-native environment where privacy, security, and good data practices are part of how we build.

 

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Technical Expertise: 3+ years building and shipping production-grade data systems, with strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, Scala etc.)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure—ideally some exposure to Terraform, Kubernetes, or similar IaC and container orchestration tools. We don't expect deep expertise in all of these, but comfort working in this kind of environment matters.
  • Experience designing data APIs or services that expose data to applications, or a strong interest in working across the analytical/operational boundary.
  • A thoughtful approach to data quality, privacy, and security—you understand that how data is used is as important as how it's moved.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across teams with different priorities—engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and product.
  • A pragmatic, curious mindset—you enjoy keeping up with the field and know when to reach for a new tool versus when to stick with what works.
  • Pipeline Management: Hands-on experience with data pipeline tools (Airflow, dbt) and strong ability to optimize for performance and reliability.
  • Quality Focus: Commitment to continuously improving product quality, security, and performance through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Documentation: Meticulous approach to creating and maintaining architecture and systems documentation.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Independence: Capability to ship medium features independently while contributing to the team's overall objectives.

 

What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that power analytics, ML workloads, and product-facing applications—from internal databases, SaaS sources, and streaming systems through to the teams and services that consume them.
  • Evolve our data platform alongside cloud platform engineers, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes-based deployments (Argo) to keep the platform scalable, reliable, and self-serve.
  • System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data infrastructure that accommodates our growing data volume and complexity.
  • Develop data services and APIs that expose trusted data to product applications, bridging analytical and operational systems.
  • Own data quality and observability, putting monitoring, testing, and alerting in place so issues are caught early and trust in the data stays high.
  • Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand their data needs and design the right solutions—not just the quickest ones.
  • Uphold strong data privacy, security, and compliance practices in everything you build, particularly where data flows into product-facing contexts.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data flows, models, and systems for knowledge sharing.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure all data systems adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements.

 

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

description:
About The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.

 What To Expect?

  • You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus. 
    • Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities. 
    • Our Application Foundations group includes design systems & information architecture, as well as workflows & automation tooling, and search & discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36. 
    • The Business Foundations group focuses on identity & access, monetization, and platform insights. 
  • You'll manage a team of designers you can genuinely invest in — coaching career growth, shaping how they work, and giving them real ownership over their piece of the platform.
  • You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership on strategy, not just execution to shape how Optimization, Application Foundations, and Business Foundations evolve.
  • You'll help define what AI-native design leadership looks like at Contentful, at a moment when the company is actively maturing that muscle. The Contentful platform includes AI powered customer facing features, and accordingly, we progressively evolve our design tooling and ways of working to take advantage of emerging technologies. 
  • You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally. 
  • Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly. 
  • You will be joining at a pivotal moment: Contentful's recent acquisition by Salesforce puts this team's work in front of a massive new customer base, giving you a rare chance to help shape design at a large scale. 

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product designers, ideally at a B2B SaaS or platform company.
  • Strong track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership at the strategy level, not just translating requirements. You will influence roadmap decisions, represent design's perspective in cross-functional planning, and drive visioning initiatives. 
  • A strong customer-centric orientation. You ground design and product decisions in real customer insights and instill that same instinct across your team.
  • A track record of design leadership that extends beyond your own team. Experience shaping and evolving the product design function’s practices within an organization. 
  • Maintain a high bar for design craft, with a portfolio reflecting strong interaction and visual design fundamentals. You set and uphold that same bar across your team by giving specific, actionable feedback that sharpens execution, not just strategy.
  • A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform. 
  • Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.
  • Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams. 
  • A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.
  • Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management. 
  • Comfort operating in a technically complex, enterprise/platform context. The interfaces and user flows we design operate within a headless, API first context and a mindset of ‘systems thinking’ is paramount.

description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

  • Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
  • Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
  • Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
  • Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
  • Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
  • Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
  • Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
  • Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
  • Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
  • Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
  • Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
  • Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
  • Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
  • Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description: lemlist is the outbound platform for sales teams: find leads, run multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls), personalize with AI and book meetings. lempire also builds lemwarm (deliverability), Claap (AI call intelligence), Taplio and Tweet Hunter. We're at +$60M ARR, growing ~50% year over year, profitable and 100% bootstrapped, with 180 people. Your mission lemlist and Claap sell through several motions at once: self-serve, sales-led, account management and partners. More than a quarter of our ARR sits in 1,200+ accounts managed by our Customer Success and Account Management teams. In 2027, these teams start working the same portfolio under a new customer segmentation, and expanding our existing accounts, including cross-selling Claap and our new products, is one of our biggest bets of the year. As Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Customer Ops), your mission is to design how our revenue motions run, and own the systems and data behind them. In the short term, your focus is customer operations, from the moment Sales hands over an account to every renewal and expansion. Over time, the role can evolve toward Sales ops, Partnerships or other revenue topics, depending on your strengths, your interests and company priorities. You'll join our Finance & Operations team, six people today, and report to Philippe, Head of Finance & Operations. Your main stakeholders are the leaders of Customer Experience, Account Management, Sales and Partnerships. This is a hands-on role. You'll spend most of your time in HubSpot, our customer tools, automations and dashboards, building things people use every day. You also bring the business view: you know your numbers better than anyone, and you turn them into clear recommendations for the teams you work with. Where you'll make an impact Your first focus: customers Give customer teams one view of every account. Bring product usage, billing and CRM data together, so every account tells the full story in one place. Own the build-or-buy decision on our customer platform, lead the rollout, and build with the Data team the dashboards that make CSMs' day-to-day easier and give leadership clear visibility on the customer base. Build our risk detection engine. Turn usage, payment and engagement signals into early alerts across the whole portfolio, from our largest accounts with a dedicated CSM to the ones we manage at scale, so teams act on churn risk weeks before a renewal. Make renewals and NRR predictable. With our VP CX and Account Management leaders, build the renewal and NRR forecast leadership can rely on, at least two quarters ahead, and know which accounts will grow, stay or churn. Turn our customer base into expansion revenue. Give Account Managers and CSMs the signals and pipeline to upsell and cross-sell Claap and our new products, and track what it brings. Also in your scope Alongside customer ops, you'll contribute to the rest of our RevOps work: Sales: make selling lemlist, Claap and new products simple for our reps, with lead routing, pipeline and performance tracking, and clear rules of engagement between Sales, Account Management and partners. Partners: make partner deals easy to track, credit and pay, from PartnerStack to the CRM, so the Partnerships team can scale its programs in Europe and the US. Systems: keep CRM and revenue data reliable as we add products, run commission plans people trust, and replace manual work with automations and AI agents. What success looks like Within your first 3 months You've audited our customer motion and shared a 12-month plan with Philippe, our VP CX and Account Management leaders. The customer platform decision is made, based on your recommendation. A first version of the churn risk alerts is live for CSMs. Within 12 months CSMs and Account Managers work from one view of every account, with usage, billing and CRM data they trust. Churn risks are flagged weeks ahead, and teams act on them before the renewal. Leadership plans on your renewal and NRR forecast You've turned the CRM into an expansion and pipeline generation tool, across lemlist and Claap. Your work contributes to a measurable lift in net revenue retention (NRR) on the managed portfolio. title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients. What you will need Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications. The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why. Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one. The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy. A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player. Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel. Fluent English. Nice-to-have Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS. A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience. Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

The Role

We have grown quickly, and our Solution Consulting team is at the center of how prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. We are looking for a Solution Consulting Manager to lead and scale that team.

This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. You will spend roughly 25% of your time running your own sales cycles (staying sharp, credible and close to the customer and product) and roughly 75% of your time coaching, mentoring and developing your team, primarily by riding shotgun on live deals and giving real-time feedback. You will also be a key voice in shaping the product and building the Solution Consulting infrastructure that lets the organization scale.

You will work directly with the CEO, GTM leadership and the Product team.

Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%)

  • Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases.

  • Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career.

  • Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly.

  • Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track.

Run your own sales cycles (~25%)

  • Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes.

  • Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process.

  • Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders.

Inform product and build for scale

  • Be the voice of the prospect. Synthesize front-line feedback, objections, competitive intel and feature gaps from across the team, and bring it to founders and Product in close to real time, with clear patterns and prioritization.

  • Influence the roadmap. Partner with Product on discovery, early feedback on new features, and how capabilities are positioned and demoed.

  • Build Solution Consulting infrastructure. Create the systems, playbooks and tools that help the team scale, such as discovery frameworks, demo standards and reusable assets, sandbox and demo-data templates, technical FAQs and objection libraries, POC and technical-validation processes, a deal-review cadence, and enablement and certification paths.

  • Measure what matters. Define and track team metrics (technical win rate, ramp time, deal coverage, cycle time) and use them to improve how the team operates.

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience across areas such as revenue recognition, month-end close and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 3+ years supporting complex ERP sales cycles with implementation and/or customer support for accounting or financial solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.

  • Excellent communicator who makes complex concepts easy to understand, and who can give direct, constructive feedback in the moment.

  • Experience building processes, enablement or tooling for a growing team, ideally in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.

  • Thrives in a dynamic environment while keeping high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit is a plus.

Life at Rillet

Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes. Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care. What is the job? As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options. Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey. The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine. Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care. Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales , delivered fully online in partnership with Learna. The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team. About the diploma A 12-month, part-time postgraduate diploma with all teaching and assessment completed online. Focuses on interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary pain management, assessment and service provision. Full course fees funded by Montu UK. Two hours of protected, paid study time each week. Further information about the programme is available through the University of South Wales . Eligibility A minimum working commitment of 24 hours per week with Montu. Two of those hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time. Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma. What will you be doing? Providing high-quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment for chronic pain and other qualifying conditions. Conducting patient consultations, including clinical assessments, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient management. Applying anaesthetic expertise in analgesic pharmacology, drug interactions and opioid stewardship to support safe prescribing. Reviewing patient progress and treatment effectiveness, making adjustments where clinically appropriate. Engaging in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence-based practice. Contributing to clinical governance and maintaining robust patient care standards. Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. Completing the sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management alongside clinical responsibilities. Participating in ongoing training and professional development, including specialist training in cannabis-based prescription medicines. What you need Full GMC registration with a current licence to practise. Completion of specialist training in Anaesthesia (CCT/CCST) or equivalent. Entry on the GMC Specialist Register for Anaesthesia. Strong knowledge of analgesic pharmacology, pain management and safe prescribing. Excellent communication skills and a patient-centred approach to care. Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary clinical team. A strong interest in chronic pain and alternative treatment options. Willingness to participate in clinical outcome data collection and reporting. Ability to commit to a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma. Previous chronic pain experience is welcome but not essential, as the sponsored diploma and comprehensive in-house training will support professional development. Why join us? Competitive Salary: £170,000 FTE, pro rata for contracted hours. Funded Postgraduate Diploma: Full course fees for the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, plus two hours of protected, paid study time each week. Flexible Working: Fully remote working with flexible clinical sessions and a minimum commitment of 24 hours per week. Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for work undertaken within the role. Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on-call requirements. Specialist Training: Access to CPD-accredited medical cannabis education and specialist training from experienced clinicians. Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals. Professional Development: Build expertise in chronic pain management and contribute to an evolving area of medicine. Training & Development Fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales. Regular CPD sessions to support ongoing professional development, appraisal and revalidation. Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant). Ongoing support and training in clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's clinical systems. Appraisal and revalidation support where Montu is the main employer. Working arrangements Remote Role: Fully remote working with flexibility around working days and hours. Weekly Commitment: A minimum of 24 hours per week, consisting of 22 hours of clinical work and two hours of protected, paid study time. Sessions: Standard clinical sessions consist of four hours of patient consultations, with flexibility to arrange sessions around preferred working days and hours. Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week is required for the duration of the diploma. If employment ends before completing the diploma or within 12 months of completion, repayment of the course fees will be required. Full repayment terms will be outlined in a separate training agreement, which must be reviewed and signed before enrolment. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey. As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments. title: Software Development Engineer in Test II, NavNative
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What We Do The Navigation Native team builds the high-performance C++ engine that serves as the "brain" of our Navigation SDKs. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr. We solve the fundamental challenges of movement: transforming noisy GPS/IMU data into precise map-matching, managing complex road-network graphs, supporting routes and alternatives, tracking progress along a route, and providing "Electronic Horizon" capabilities for ADAS. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons. As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You'll Do We are looking for smart, fast-learning engineers who care as much about proving that navigation works as about making it work. As an SDE(T), you will: Build and maintain the unit, integration, and functional test architecture for a C++17 library, and the CMake and CI pipelines that run it. Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following. Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage. Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review. Partner with feature engineers on testability and review designs for how they will be verified. Thoughtfully leverage AI tools in your workflow and set the standard for how the team uses them. What We Believe Are Important Traits for This Role 5+ years of experience in C++17: comfortable writing test code and tooling, reading production code, and debugging with sanitizers and profilers. Python or similar for harnesses and analysis. Proven experience building test infrastructure for a large native codebase: test frameworks, CMake, and CI systems. A data-driven mindset: you define metrics, build the tooling to measure them, and use them to argue for or against a change. Experience diagnosing hard-to-reproduce failures: flakiness, platform-specific behavior, memory and threading bugs. Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders. Would be a Plus Familiarity with navigation concepts (map matching, dead reckoning, route progress, or Electronic Horizon). Experience with replay- or simulation-based testing using real sensor and GPS data. Hands-on experience building AI- or agent-based developer tooling for testing, code review, or triage. Experience with coverage tooling, performance benchmarking, or testing SDKs through generated bindings. Employment Requirements Employment Type: Full-time Weekly Hours: 40 h per week Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany) What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How We Support You Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth. Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. About the Role
We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

  • Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost

  • Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost

  • Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use

  • Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping

  • Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams

  • Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope

  • Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work)

  • Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class

  • Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions

  • Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints

  • Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process

  • Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus)

  • Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing)

  • Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation)

  • Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware

  • Prior startup or skunkworks experience

  • Contribute to Mistral's broader pre and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description: Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen. Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist. In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings. Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft. Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab. Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen. Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail. Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz. Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
