title: Senior Fullstack Developer .NET
description: Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur. Als Senior Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je beweegt je vanzelfsprekend tussen frontend en backend, bouwt zelf mee aan nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd onze applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren. Daarbij kijken we nadrukkelijk naar jou om technische richting en structuur te helpen aanbrengen . Niet door keuzes alleen te maken, maar juist door technische vraagstukken scherp te krijgen, verschillende perspectieven bij elkaar te brengen en samen met het team tot goede, gedragen oplossingen te komen. 1. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX. Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor je eigen code, maar kijkt ook naar de samenhang en kwaliteit van de oplossing als geheel. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: ontwikkelen van nieuwe backendfunctionaliteit in C#/.NET ; ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van frontendfunctionaliteit met één van de grote frontend frameworks ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's, integraties en dataoplossingen; maken van technische ontwerpen die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden; schrijven en stimuleren van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code; bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps ; analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en deze vertalen naar pragmatische oplossingen; aanbrengen van technische structuur en bewaken van samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie; richting geven aan architectuur- en ontwerpkeuzes en inzichtelijk maken van de consequenties van verschillende opties; begeleiden van technische discussies en ervoor zorgen dat kennis en ideeën van andere teamleden worden meegenomen; ondersteunen van collega-developers bij complexe technische vraagstukken; herkennen en bespreekbaar maken van technische schuld, risico's en mogelijkheden voor verbetering; stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX. Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen . Als senior developer help je het team om die afweging bewust te maken. Soms betekent dat investeren in een structurele technische verbetering, soms juist kiezen voor een pragmatische oplossing die past bij de situatie. 2. De technische uitdaging OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Daardoor werk je niet alleen aan de vraag: “Hoe bouwen we deze feature?” maar juist ook aan vragen als: “Hoe past deze oplossing in de rest van onze architectuur?” “Welke keuze helpt ons niet alleen vandaag, maar ook over een paar jaar?” “Hoe voorkomen we dat verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie ieder hun eigen richting opgaan?” En misschien nog belangrijker: “Hoe komen we als team tot een technische keuze waar verschillende inzichten goed in zijn meegenomen?” Als Senior Fullstack Developer neem je hierin het voortouw. Je kunt een technisch vraagstuk structureren, alternatieven onderzoeken en een richting voorstellen. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat de beste technische oplossing zelden door één persoon wordt bedacht. Je zoekt actief de discussie met andere developers, luistert naar argumenten en gebruikt de expertise binnen het team om de uiteindelijke oplossing beter te maken. Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer. Technisch leiderschap betekent bij ons dus niet bepalen wat anderen moeten bouwen, maar richting geven, structuur aanbrengen en het team helpen betere technische keuzes te maken. 3. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken een ervaren developer die zich daadwerkelijk thuis voelt aan beide kanten van de stack . Voor deze seniorrol zoeken we dus niet naar een backenddeveloper die af en toe frontendwerk doet, of andersom. Je hoeft niet overal dezelfde diepgang te hebben, maar je bent in staat om zelfstandig aan zowel frontend als backend te werken en kunt technische vraagstukken over de volledige keten overzien. Je: hebt een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau op het gebied van Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting; hebt ruime professionele ervaring met C# en .NET ; hebt ruime ervaring met moderne frontendontwikkeling en kunt zelfstandig werken met één van de grote frontend frameworks hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van API's en integraties; hebt gedegen kennis van databases en begrijpt hoe keuzes in de datalaag doorwerken naar backend en frontend; kunt technische oplossingen ontwerpen over meerdere lagen van een applicatie; hebt een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en kunt architectuurprincipes toepassen zonder de pragmatiek uit het oog te verliezen; hebt oog voor aspecten als onderhoudbaarheid, testbaarheid, performance, security en technische schuld; bent gewend te werken met CI/CD, automated testing en een Agile/Scrum-werkwijze; kunt complexe technische vraagstukken structureren en terugbrengen tot heldere keuzes; durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is en kunt duidelijk uitleggen waarom een bepaalde richting wordt gekozen; staat tegelijkertijd open voor andere inzichten en bent bereid je eigen oplossing ter discussie te stellen; helpt minder ervaren developers groeien door kennis te delen, feedback te geven en samen naar oplossingen te zoeken; communiceert gemakkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's. Wat maakt jou senior? Voor ons zit senioriteit niet alleen in het aantal jaren ervaring of hoeveel technologieën je beheerst. We zoeken iemand die over de grenzen van een individuele feature heen kijkt . Je ziet patronen en afhankelijkheden, herkent wanneer een technische keuze gevolgen heeft voor andere onderdelen van het systeem en brengt structuur aan wanneer een vraagstuk complex wordt. Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen.

Als Senior Fullstack Developer neem je hierin het voortouw. Je kunt een technisch vraagstuk structureren, alternatieven onderzoeken en een richting voorstellen. raw.description:
Transportbedrijven staan voor grote veranderingen. Digitalisering, SaaS, data, integraties, automatisering en AI bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden. Maar technologie alleen lost niets op. Het begint met begrijpen hoe een klant werkt, waar processen vastlopen, welke verandering nodig is en waar werkelijk waarde kan worden toegevoegd.

Daarom zoeken wij een Senior Business Consultant Transport voor onze locatie in Hoogeveen. Iemand die niet begint met onze software, maar met de business van de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Jij doorgrondt logistieke processen, ziet kansen en krijgt organisaties in beweging.

Hoe kunnen transportorganisaties slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendiger werken? Als Senior Business Consultant Transport help jij onze klanten om die stap te zetten. Je bent een strategische gesprekspartner voor planners, key-users, IT, operations en management. Je begrijpt hun processen en uitdagingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen en slimme oplossingen.

Je kijkt verder dan de technologie alleen. Je onderzoekt wat een organisatie écht nodig heeft en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen niet alleen worden bedacht en geïmplementeerd, maar ook daadwerkelijk worden omarmd en toegepast.

Welke werkzaamheden kan je verder verwachten?

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van transport- en logistieke processen.

  • Leiden van workshops en adviseren van klanten over procesverbetering en digitalisering.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete requirements en oplossingsrichtingen.

  • Adviseren over SaaS, integraties, data, automatisering en AI.

  • Begeleiden van verandertrajecten, van analyse en advies tot implementatie en adoptie.

  • Creëren van draagvlak en meenemen van stakeholders op alle niveaus.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen en bijdragen aan demo's, offertes en businesscases.

  • Vertalen van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar nieuwe toepassingen, samen met Product Owners en de business.

  • Delen van kennis en coachen van collega-consultants.

Meer dan alleen consultancy

We zoeken geen consultant die zich uitsluitend richt op software of configuraties. We zoeken iemand die de vraag achter de vraag ontdekt, processen durft uit te dagen en klanten helpt écht stappen vooruit te zetten.

Je combineert inhoudelijke expertise met commercieel inzicht. Doordat je dicht bij de klant staat, herken je kansen voor aanvullende oplossingen en dienstverlening. Je weet deze te vertalen naar concrete meerwaarde voor de klant en onze organisatie.

Technologie én mensen in beweging brengen

Je hebt affiniteit met technologie en volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van SaaS, API's, data, automatisering en AI. Je hoeft geen developer te zijn, maar weet technologische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar praktische toepassingen.

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat succesvolle verandering begint bij mensen. Je herkent verschillende belangen, maakt weerstand bespreekbaar en weet organisaties mee te nemen in een nieuwe manier van werken. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan de go-live: het gaat om daadwerkelijk gebruik en blijvend resultaat.

Jij adviseert niet alleen hoe het beter kan, maar zorgt ervoor dat het ook écht beter wordt.

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als senior business consultant rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de €4.200,- en €5.000,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,25 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

  • hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

  • ruime ervaring als business consultant, businessanalist, solution consultant of in een vergelijkbare rol;

  • aantoonbare affiniteit met of ervaring in transport en logistiek;

  • ervaring met verandermanagement, stakeholdermanagement en gebruikersadoptie;

  • het vermogen om zelfstandig bedrijfsprocessen te analyseren en te verbeteren;

  • de senioriteit om gemakkelijk te schakelen tussen operatie, IT, management en directie;

  • ervaring met workshops, interviews, analyses en presentaties;

  • het vermogen om weerstand te herkennen en om te zetten in betrokkenheid;

  • commerciële nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om kansen om te zetten naar een concreet vervolg;

  • interesse in technologische ontwikkelingen en hun praktische toepassing;

  • het vermogen om complexe onderwerpen eenvoudig en overtuigend uit te leggen;

  • de drive om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en collega’s inhoudelijk sterker te maken.

Kennis van onze producten is mooi meegenomen, maar niet doorslaggevend. Productkennis kunnen we je leren. Analytisch vermogen, nieuwsgierigheid, veranderkracht en het vermogen om een klant echt verder te helpen vinden we belangrijker.

That’s where you come in. As our Security Engineer, you’ll own how 700 colleagues get secure access to our systems, and you’ll help defend bunq against attacks as they happen. You’ll design and build security processes that AI can’t run on its own, and automate everything that it can.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll keep bunq secure, from access control to incident response. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Own access control governance in Okta Identity Governance, automating how access is granted, revoked and reviewed, so every employee and contractor has the right access from day one.

  • Investigate and triage security incidents and vulnerability findings, decide whether they’re malicious, and escalate or fix them fast.

  • Drive the replacement of our security monitoring system with an AI-based platform that detects and stops threats automatically, and build automations so the team can focus on real security issues.


  • You’ve worked hands-on as a security engineer, investigating and triaging security incidents.

  • You write code to automate security work, not just to run scripts.

  • You’ve worked with identity governance and know how to build secure login and access solutions.

  • You communicate clearly with stakeholders, especially under pressure when someone is locked out or an incident hits.

  • You bring engineering experience. Consultancy experience alone isn’t the right fit.

Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app, it only takes 5 minutes to sign up.

Your space to perform

We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪

🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset

👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly.

🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration

🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office.

📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget

🧘 €60 monthly allowance via Alleo by Epassi, rolling over monthly and resetting annually

🚌﻿ Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳)

﻿💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us

🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options

💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq

💸 Monthly contribution to your phone and internet bills

🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style﻿

All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare. Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be. We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉 Your role You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems. This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan. What you will be doing, among others: Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps. Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through. Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies. Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed. Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership. Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations. Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks. You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you. You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

OneStream Developer

Location: Philippines

Join our rapidly growing Technology Enablement practice as a trusted advisor to clients, blending deep technical expertise to deliver tailored and integrated solutions that help our clients solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on technical resource on OneStream implementation projects, focusing on system integrations, business rule development, and technical architecture, partnering closely with US-based teams to build scalable, high-performing EPM solutions.

What You'll Do

Technical Delivery & Development

  • Provide hands-on development throughout all phases of OneStream implementations, including business rule development, data integration, metadata configuration, and technical testing
  • Design and build integrations between OneStream and ERP/source systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday) using connectors, ETL tools, REST APIs, and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS)
  • Develop and maintain data models, cube views, dashboards, and custom workflows within the OneStream platform
  • Translate functional requirements into technical designs, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with client architecture standards
  • Perform complex data validations, resolve data variance and business rule issues, and ensure compliance with design and process requirements
  • Collaborate with functional consultants and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical designs, ensuring solutions align with client objectives

Managed Services & Support

  • Provide technical post-go-live support across managed services engagements, including break/fix resolution, system enhancements, and performance optimization
  • Support recurring close cycle activities from a technical perspective, troubleshooting integration and data issues as they arise
  • Maintain technical documentation including integration specs, data flow diagrams, and configuration records

AI & Innovation

  • Contribute to developing and implementing firm-approved, AI-enabled solutions for clients, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards
  • Stay informed about emerging AI tools, automation techniques, and EPM platform capabilities; collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years of hands-on OneStream development experience, including business rule writing in VB.NET or C# and technical configuration
  • Experience designing and building system integrations into EPM platforms, including ERP connectors (SAP, Oracle, Workday), ETL tools, REST APIs, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS)
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata structures, and EPM architecture concepts
  • Experience with other EPM tools (e.g., Oracle, Hyperion, Anaplan, Adaptive) is a strong plus
  • 5–7 years of experience in a technical consulting, financial systems, or EPM development role
  • Comfort with AI: Demonstrated ability to responsibly explore and adopt firm-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Openness to learning and applying emerging technologies including AI and automation in alignment with firm policies and client standards

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or similar discipline
  • OneStream certification required; OneStream Architect certification preferred
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams across time zones

Compensation

Additional Information

By joining our rapidly growing Coupa practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You’ll bring your first-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional and technical knowledge to deliver tailored integrated solutions that help our clients solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. What You'll Do

  • Advise key stakeholders through selection, transformation, implementation, and configuration of Coupa.   • Utilize a broad array of technical experience encompassing the full Coupa suite –Procurement, Payables, Expenses and Asset Management

The ideal candidate will possess an extensive technical background in electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) systems, infrared phenomenology, OPIR data analysis, and remote-sensing software development.   • Detailed experience with OPIR data formats and processing pipelines.
  • Advanced Python development skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose sensor-performance issues, data anomalies, and software problems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience performing OPIR analysis.
  • Master’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience collaborating with NGA, NASIC, or other Intelligence Community organizations.

title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Hey there! We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Data Team. This is a role for an engineer who cares deeply about product impact, user experience, and how systems connect to real business outcomes. You will work across the full stack, from the interfaces users interact with to the services and data layers that power them, and bridge the gap between our AI and data capabilities and the products people actually use. You won't just take tickets and ship code. You'll own features end-to-end: shaping the problem with Product and Design, building it, defining success metrics, and iterating based on real data. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in. Tech environment This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation. Nice to have Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one. Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them. Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults. Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems. Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI. Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications. Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns. Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar). raw.jobDescription:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Data Team. This is a role for an engineer who cares deeply about product impact, user experience, and how systems connect to real business outcomes. You will work across the full stack, from the interfaces users interact with to the services and data layers that power them, and bridge the gap between our AI and data capabilities and the products people actually use. You won't just take tickets and ship code. You'll own features end-to-end: shaping the problem with Product and Design, building it, defining success metrics, and iterating based on real data. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in.

Tech environment

This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one.
  • Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them.
  • Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults.
  • Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems.
  • Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar).
  • Exposure to AI-enabled product development: LLM integrations, agent frameworks (LangGraph/LangChain), LLM observability (Langfuse), RAG patterns, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. Product tracking at Fever runs through Dataverse, our in-house unified behavioural event layer built on server-side GTM, so knowing how GA and GTM work is enough to find your way around. We also use Mixpanel.
  • Familiarity with product experimentation: A/B testing, feature flags, and edge-side experimentation. We bucket anonymous users and run rollouts at the CDN edge (CloudFront Functions), with Statsig and Optimizely as the experimentation platforms.
  • Experience working on 0 to 1 initiatives or undefined problem spaces.
  • Demonstrated leadership through ownership of difficult projects with broad impact.

What success looks like

  • You turn ambiguous opportunities into working systems or products that create clear value.
  • You help teams make better trade-offs and avoid overengineering, fragmentation, and local optimization.
  • You improve not only what gets built, but also how decisions are made.
  • You become a trusted technical leader for important cross-functional initiatives.
  • You increase the leverage of other engineers and teams through your judgment, technical direction, and execution support.
  • You help connect engineering work to real operational and business outcomes.

Who will thrive in this role

You will likely thrive here if:

  • You are energized by ambitious, messy, high-leverage problems.
  • You like operating where priorities evolve and the path is not fully defined.
  • You care more about impact than about staying inside a narrowly defined engineering lane.
  • You enjoy combining engineering depth, product thinking, and business context.
  • You naturally look for the highest-leverage way to move a system, a team, or a product forward.
  • You want to play a meaningful role in shaping how the company builds and scales.

Why join Fever

  • You will work on some of the company's most strategic problems.
  • You will have real ownership and visible impact.
  • You will help shape products, systems, and capabilities that matter across the business.
  • You will work in an environment that values ambition, adaptability, pragmatism, and execution.
  • You will be surrounded by smart, driven people who care about building things that matter.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible schedule
  • Bonus
  • Stock options
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health insurance from Day 1
  • English or Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport)
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer. You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers. Why this role exists Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability. Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused. What you’ll do Product contribution Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems. Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work. Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability. Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations. Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns. Strategic technical stewardship Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk. Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments. Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff. Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture. Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering. AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers. Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations. Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery. Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements. Thought leadership Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach. Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks. Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab. Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability. What you’ll bring Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems. Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security. Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems. Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments. Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns. Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery. Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations. The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority. Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization. Strongly preferred qualifications Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed. Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools. Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior. Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents. A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems. Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments. Technologies and domains Directly relevant technologies and domains include: Ruby on Rails Go AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC PostgreSQL Redis and Sidekiq Git internals GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture Kubernetes and containers Terraform Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis Vue and TypeScript APIs and automation DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance What this role is not This role isn't: A generic field engineering role. A proof-of-concept factory. A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering. A customer-specific customization function. Unbilled Professional Services. A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product. An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution. Success measures Success in this role may include: Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks. Fixing product bugs or contributing features. Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts. Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners. Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives. Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering. Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field. Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts. About the team The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency. Ideal candidate profile You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome. You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application. raw.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. title: Freelance Software Tester | Remote in Belgium
description: Hi there! We're Testlio , a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012. We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers. Learn more about us at www.testlio.com . About This Opportunity We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager. Requirements: Location & Payment Method: Italy: Satispay account. Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account. Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account. Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account. Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app. Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English. Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026. Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours. Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment. Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? You can still apply if you're willing and eligible to set it up before testing. What You'll Do: Follow step-by-step instructions from our testing team. Add a local payment method to Meta Ads Manager. Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5. Check whether the payment goes through successfully. Report any errors or unexpected behavior, including screenshots when needed. Why do we need local testers? Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly. Your role is to follow simple instructions, complete a small authorized transaction, and tell us whether everything worked as expected. No previous software testing experience is required! Privacy & Security We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously. You'll receive instructions for the assigned testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive banking information in your reports. If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps. Official recruitment emails will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox! #LI-REMOTE

description: Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security. Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it. About The Role We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management. We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs. What You'll Do 1. Overall Software Architecture Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end. Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs. Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become. 2. Data Handling & Pipeline Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled. Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable. Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply. 3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity. Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work. Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output. 4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use. What We're Looking For Required Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time. Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity. Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself. At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them. Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place. Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else. Strongly Preferred TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus. Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling. Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes). Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl , or similar). Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform. What Valinor Offers Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others. Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year. We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey. Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us. This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required. Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.
  • Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.
  • Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.
  • Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.
  • Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.
  • Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

  • You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.
  • You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.
  • A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.
  • You are enthusiastic about AI technologies, use AI tools daily in your work, and proactively learn and experiment with how to adopt AI to boost engineering outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines, with experience in tools like Jenkins for automating builds and deployments.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (we use Grafana, Kibana, and others) to keep services healthy and define SLIs/SLOs.
  • Experience working with relational and in-memory databases.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional peers (Product, Analytics, SRE).
  • Experience in mentoring other engineers, providing constructive feedback, and promoting engineering best practices within your team.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • A daily lunch allowance
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • An NS mobility card
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.
